purpose: Express ability using the potential form.
keywords: Ichidan stem + られる; 来る → 来られる.
You can see the sea from here.
formation: Ichidan stem + られる; 来る → 来られる.
restrictions: られる also forms passive and honorific expressions; context determines the use.
mistake: Avoid assuming every られる expresses ability.
